moments.title: Root scraps England cricket curfew
moments.blurb: New England Test captain Joe Root has abolished the midnight curfew for the men's team, encouraging players to 'be adults' ahead of the Pakistan series starting next week.

angles.name: Curfew's Out
angles.copy: Joe Root says 'be adults' as he scraps the England cricket team's midnight curfew. Big week for the Test squad ahead of the Pakistan series. Your thoughts on the new approach?

angles.name: Adults Only
angles.copy: No more midnight curfews for the England Test squad! Joe Root's telling them to 'be adults'. Bold move or common sense? Cricket talk on Nation Radio.

moments.title: Hudson-Smith wins European 400m gold
moments.blurb: Matthew Hudson-Smith, 31, stormed to his third European 400m title at the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham today, thrilling the home crowd.

angles.name: Gold for Hudson-Smith
angles.copy: Another European 400m gold for Matthew Hudson-Smith in Birmingham! What a performance from the 31-year-old. Pure class on home soil.

angles.name: Britain's Best
angles.copy: Three European 400m titles and counting! Matthew Hudson-Smith makes history today. Who's your favourite British athlete right now?

moments.title: England Mixed Disability cricket series level
moments.blurb: The England Men's Mixed Disability team won a last-ball thriller against India today to level their Vitality IT20 series 2-2, with three matches remaining this weekend and next Wednesday at Lord's.

angles.name: Thriller at Hove
angles.copy: What a game! England Men's Mixed Disability team snatch a last-ball victory to level the series against India. Catch the next matches this weekend!

angles.name: Series Decider Ahead
angles.copy: It's 2-2! The England Men's Mixed Disability series against India is going down to the wire. Who's ready for a Lord's decider next week?

moments.title: Premier League season kicks off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially kicks off on Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal facing Coventry City, and Hull City playing Manchester United on Saturday.

angles.name: Football's Back!
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League returns next Friday, August 21st! Which fixture are you most looking forward to?

angles.name: New Season Hype
angles.copy: Get ready for kick-off! Arsenal, Man Utd, and all your favourite teams are back in action from next Friday. Who's lifting the trophy this season?

moments.title: Boomtown Festival kicks off
moments.blurb: Boomtown Festival, the immersive music and arts event, is live this week in Hampshire, running from August 12-16, 2026.

angles.name: Boomtown is ON
angles.copy: Chapter Three is officially underway! Boomtown Festival is alive with music, art, and immersive experiences in Hampshire all week. Who's there?

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: From the South East to the world – Boomtown is bringing the party! What's been your highlight so far from this year's festival?

moments.title: Ariana Grande's O2 residency begins
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's highly anticipated ten-night 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' residency at London's O2 Arena kicks off on August 15, marking her first live performances in six years.

angles.name: Ariana Returns
angles.copy: She's back! Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' hits The O2 on Friday for a massive ten-night residency. Who managed to get tickets?

angles.name: Pop Event of the Summer
angles.copy: London is about to get a whole lot sweeter! Ariana Grande takes over The O2 for her only UK dates. Get ready for some pop perfection!

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his record-breaking 'After Hours Til Dawn Stadium Tour' to Wembley Stadium for five nights, starting August 14, 2026.

angles.name: Wembley is Calling
angles.copy: The Weeknd is taking over Wembley Stadium for five nights starting tomorrow! Expect an epic show from the 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour. Who's ready?

angles.name: After Hours Til Dawn
angles.copy: Five nights of The Weeknd at Wembley! If you're heading to the shows this week, what's the one song you NEED to hear live?

moments.title: Green Man Festival returns to Wales
moments.blurb: The Green Man Festival, a beloved independent music and arts festival, returns to the Brecon Beacons, Wales, from August 15-18, 2026.

angles.name: Green Man Magic
angles.copy: The Brecon Beacons are calling! Green Man Festival kicks off this Friday for four days of incredible music, arts, and Welsh magic. Who's heading to Crickhowell?

angles.name: Welsh Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Green Man Festival is almost here! Get ready for a weekend of brilliant acts and beautiful scenery in the heart of Wales. What are you most excited for?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of August 7-13, marking its 20th week at the top. Ariana Grande also has new entries 'petal' and 'kiss me' in the Top 40.

angles.name: Chart Reign
angles.copy: 20 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still dominating the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. Plus, new Ariana Grande tracks hit the Top 40!

angles.name: New Chart Hits
angles.copy: It's the Official Singles Chart update! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still riding high, and Ariana Grande has two new entries. What's your favourite new track?

moments.title: UK heatwave continues, record summer likely
moments.blurb: The UK is experiencing sustained high temperatures, with another heatwave expected this week and forecasts indicating it's 'increasingly likely' to be the warmest summer on record.

angles.name: Heatwave Alert
angles.copy: Another heatwave is hitting the UK this week, with temperatures set to soar! Stay cool, stay hydrated, and enjoy the sunshine responsibly. #UKWeather #Heatwave

angles.name: Record Summer?
angles.copy: It's looking like the warmest UK summer on record! How are you beating the heat this week? Let us know your top tips!

moments.title: Mark Knopfler turns 77

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Mark Knopfler, the genius behind Dire Straits. Still making incredible music at 77!
